description: Guides secure uploads to a review-ready evidence package without deciding eligibility or writing policy.

invocation.rationale: The partner collaborates until intake is complete; the autonomous fleet starts only after a review-ready handoff exists.

tier1.rationale: Intake state lives in the tenant-scoped document service, not the screening run scratchpad.

tier2.rationale: The partner cannot alter the autonomous fleet's audit ledger.

tier3.rationale: Applicant evidence must never become institutional policy. The partner reads policy only through a trusted catalog tool.

guardrails.rationale: Raw extracted documents are screened at ingestion; agent tools return manifests, redacted citations, and structured evidence only.
